address: 57 Ho Xuan Huong Street, Xuan Hoa Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 72407, Vietnam
bio: Popular among the locals and tourists alike, this unpretentious eatery shares a bungalow with an ice cream parlour and specialises in traditional Vietnamese dishes and French snacks. If you find the vast menu a bit daunting, the tasting menu is a great way to sample all the signature dishes. Try the assorted spring rolls, featuring a delightful variety of types on one plate, each filled with unique ingredients and crafted in different styles....
